name: A & N Custom Fabrication Inc
old_description: Vegas Custom Fabrication has been the vendor of choice for many companies and individuals since 1977. We currently supply metal fabricated assemblies and services for customers throughout the Las Vegas valley including Las Vegas, North Las Vegas, Sunrise Mountain, Nellis, Green Valley, Henderson, Boulder City, and Summerlin.  We serve the construction, manufacturing, hospitality, government, gaming and a variety of other industries for over 30 years!
about:
Vegas Custom Fabrication, operating in Las Vegas, Nevada, traces its roots to 1977 when A & N Fabrication opened just west of the Las Vegas Strip. The second-generation, family-owned shop was taken over by Ron Nelson in August 2026, continuing a legacy of serving casinos, construction firms, and government agencies such as Clark County.

The company specializes in heavy-duty press brake forming with machines ranging from 50 to 1,500 tons, allowing complex parts to be produced in a single piece without splice welding. In-house capabilities include waterjet cutting, sand blasting, painting, punching, and precision welding — flux-core arc (FCAW), gas metal arc (GMAW/MIG), and gas tungsten arc (GTAW/TIG) — on aluminum, carbon steel, stainless steel, and T1 and Domex alloys. Powder coating is sourced through long-standing vendor partners. The shop handles both one-off prototypes and large production runs.

Customers span construction, manufacturing, hospitality, gaming, and government sectors. Typical output includes custom steel bollards, brackets, frames, guards, job boxes, ladder racks, machine and robot bases, material storage solutions, panels, racks, service boxes, tables, jacketed and non-jacketed tanks, welded components, weldments, wire troughs, and wireways.

The firm emphasizes quick turn-around, competitive pricing, and worldwide shipping, positioning its versatility and caring customer service as key differentiators. By consolidating multiple operations under one roof, it aims to reduce assembly time and material waste for clients.
